text:
aj: Hey @maria / people-ops — candidate verbally accepted. Wants to start 2025-01-03 (two weeks earlier than our typical 4-week buffer). Requested base is $250,000 which exceeds the IC3 band top of $230,000. Also asking for relocation. Need routing for comp-band exception + confirmation on early start viability.

maria: Thanks @aj. Quick checklist: (1) manager justification, (2) candidate current comp evidence (offer / payslip), (3) headcount approval from finance. We'll then route to comp for exception. Can you gather docs?

sam: Candidate is exceptional, immediate product impact. Current base + bonus = $240k and equity ~40k/year. 250k base is market for this role. Hiring manager requests a provisional uplift (timeboxed, 6 months) if full band change isn't approved immediately.

leo: We prefer not to permanently re-band mid-cycle. For cases like this we can approve a provisional uplift up to ~10-12% with a 6-month review and a memo to the comp committee. Please complete the comp-exception form: https://redwood.internal/hr/comp-exceptions (fill: role, current comp, requested comp, justification, headcount code).

aj: Filling it out now — adding current offer screenshot.

hr-bot: ACTION ITEMS: 1) attach evidence, 2) headcount code, 3) hiring mgr justification, 4) finance approval if uplift >10%, 5) signed offer for payroll. Use workflow: aj -> maria -> leo -> kira (CFO) if >10% breach.

jen: Legal: if relocation included, add relocation clause + repayment terms if they leave within 12 months. Send draft language and I'll review.

maria: Proposed routing: aj -> maria (people-ops) approve docs -> leo (comp) prepare memo -> kira (CFO) if uplift >10% -> kona (payroll) for start date payroll cutoffs. Note payroll cutoffs: payroll needs signed docs 10 business days before start for full-cycle onboarding.

aj: Candidate says they can flex to 2025-01-10 if we need payroll time, but strongly prefers 2025-01-03. I can ask them to confirm a hard latest start date.

sam: If we lose Jan 3 candidate likely accepts competitor. Please expedite.

leo: I'll prepare the comp memo with market comps and recommend provisional uplift of 10% timeboxed 6 months, with a formal review that may move them into the band if performance and budget support it. ETA EOD today.

maria: Tagging @kira and @kona for finance/payroll input.

kira: CFO here — provisional uplift up to 12% is okay for top-tier external hires provided it's timeboxed to 6 months and scoped into this quarter's operating plan. Must include a one-line budget note and headcount confirmation. Kira :ok_hand:

kona: Payroll note: to onboard 2025-01-03 we need signed offer and bank/ID details by 2024-12-27 COB. If docs arrive later we can do Jan 10 start; otherwise earliest paid payroll for Jan 3 start is after first pay run (confirm with AP). If candidate needs an advance, payroll can request APR submission.

aj: Thanks everyone — I'll submit comp-exception form, add the evidence, and update candidate to hold Jan 10 as fallback. Will ping once memo is up.

maria: Sounds good. Once comp memo + finance sign-off are in, I'll approve routing and Jen will finalize legal language. Please keep thread updated. :thumbsup: 

sam: Ack. I'll hold candidate and push urgency.

aj: Uploaded docs and the comp-exception form -> https://redwood.internal/hr/files/1932109876-docs. leo flagged for memo.

leo: Memo posted in drive, short summary attached in form. I recommend provisional uplift 10% (from $230k band top to $253k) for 6 months; action: comp committee to review at month 5.

maria: Approving routing to CFO now. 

kira: Approved in principle (see note above). Finance will confirm headcount code via email.

kona: Noted. Waiting on signed offer and bank details.

aj: Will close loop when offer accepted and signed. Thanks all.

maria: Closing for now; re-open if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
